这篇写给两类玩家：一是刚下空岛、觉得弓“伤害低、箭不够用”的新手；二是已经能打人马、想把弓练成主力输出的老玩家。前者看前四节就能立刻变强，后者重点看五连刷法与资源优先级。

This article is written for two kinds of players: first, newcomers who have just left the Sky Islands and find the bow weak and arrows always in short supply; second, veteran players who can already beat Lynels and want to train the bow into their main damage source. The former will get noticeably stronger just by reading the first four sections, while the latter should focus on the five-shot farming method and resource priority.
前置条件很低：只要拿到过一把弓、背包里有箭就能练。箭的常规来源是各村庄杂货店与驿站商店，前期别省——箭是消耗品，不是收藏品。弓的格子不够时，先把低攻击的旧弓扔掉，别为了“以后可能有用”占着格子。

The prerequisites are very low: you can practice as long as you have picked up a bow and have arrows in your inventory. The regular sources of arrows are village general stores and stable shops, so do not skimp early on, since arrows are consumables, not collectibles. When you run out of bow slots, throw away low-attack old bows first, and do not keep them on the chance they might be useful later.

多连弓一发只消耗 1 支箭和 1 份余料，却能打出 3 发甚至 5 发的伤害；兽神弓 32×3 是后期毕业弓，五连词条要靠岩石巨人刷；眼睛箭打移动目标、炸弹花打群怪、高伤余料打 Boss，分工越清楚，箭花得越值。

A multi-shot bow consumes only 1 arrow and 1 portion of Fuse material per shot, yet deals the damage of 3 or even 5 shots; the Savage Lynel Bow at 32×3 is the late-game endgame bow, and its five-shot modifier must be farmed from Rock Octoroks; eyeball arrows for moving targets, Bomb Flowers for groups, and high-damage materials for Bosses, and the clearer the division of labor, the more each arrow is worth.
王国之泪里有一类弓一次射出多支箭，面板写作“32×3”这种形式，意思是每支箭 32 点攻击、一次射 3 支。理解这条机制，是整篇攻略的地基：

Tears of the Kingdom has a class of bows that fire multiple arrows at once, shown on the stat panel in the form 32×3, meaning 32 attack per arrow and 3 arrows per shot. Understanding this mechanic is the foundation of the whole guide:
只消耗 1 支箭。三连弓一发 3 支箭，背包里的箭只少 1 支；余料也一样，一发只消耗 1 份余料，却能让 3 支箭全带上余料效果。这是多连弓强大的根本原因。

Only consumes 1 arrow. A triple-shot bow fires 3 arrows per shot, but only 1 arrow leaves your inventory; Fuse materials work the same way, with just 1 portion consumed while all 3 arrows carry the Fuse effect. This is the fundamental reason multi-shot bows are so powerful.

伤害按支算，命中才算数。兽神弓 32×3 的理论伤害是 96，但远距离散开后常常只有 1 支命中，实际伤害就只有 32。离得越近，命中支数越多，伤害越接近理论值。

Damage is counted per arrow, and only hits count. The Savage Lynel Bow at 32×3 has a theoretical damage of 96, but at long range the spread often leaves only 1 arrow hitting, so actual damage is just 32. The closer you are, the more arrows hit, and the closer damage gets to the theoretical value.

散布是双刃剑。近距离打大体型目标（人马、巨霸迦马、格里奥克）几乎全中；远距离打小目标反而可能全偏。对小目标用单发高攻弓，对大目标用多连弓，这个分工要刻在脑子里。

Spread is a double-edged sword. At close range against large targets (Lynels, Colgera, Gleeoks), nearly every arrow hits; at long range against small targets, they may all miss instead. For small targets use a high-attack single-shot bow, and for large targets use a multi-shot bow, a division of labor to burn into your brain.

新手最常见的误解就是反着来：拿着三连弓远远地狙击小怪，打不中还以为弓弱；或者舍不得用多连弓，觉得“一发 3 支箭太浪费”——其实它比单发弓更省箭。

The most common beginner misunderstanding is doing it backwards: sniping small monsters from far away with a triple-shot bow, missing, and concluding the bow is weak; or refusing to use a multi-shot bow because one shot firing 3 arrows feels wasteful, when in fact it saves arrows compared with a single-shot bow.

作者视角的判断：不要一上来就追兽神弓。前期人马打不过，硬追只会浪费时间；先用骑士之弓加王族之弓推图，等能稳定打白鬃人马了，兽神弓自然会来。弓的毕业不是一把弓，而是“一把单发狙击弓加一把多连弓”的组合。

The author's verdict: do not chase the Savage Lynel Bow right away. Early on you cannot beat Lynels, and chasing it will only waste time; first clear the map with the Knight's Bow and the Royal Bow, and once you can reliably beat White-Maned Lynels, the Savage Lynel Bow will come naturally. A bow endgame is not one bow, but the combination of one single-shot sniper bow and one multi-shot bow.

In Tears of the Kingdom, arrow damage comes mainly from Fuse materials, and the bow is just the launcher. Arrows are only worth their cost when divided by situation:
蝙蝠眼睛（追踪箭）：打移动与飞行目标。余料附上蝙蝠眼睛后箭会自己追踪，专治蝙蝠、会飞的怪物和跑动中的目标。配多连弓时多支箭会一同追踪，清飞行怪极快。但别拿它打静止杂兵，浪费。

Keese Eyeballs (homing arrows): for moving and flying targets. Once a Keese Eyeball is fused, arrows home in on their own, perfect for Keese, flying monsters, and running targets. With a multi-shot bow, multiple arrows home in together, clearing flying monsters extremely fast. But do not use them on stationary small fry, as that is a waste.

Arrow-saving habits: save ordinary arrows for stationary targets and finishing blows; use eyeball arrows only on moving targets; use Bomb Flowers only on clustered targets. Once the division of labor is clear, arrows will always be enough.

The Savage Lynel Bow comes with triple-shot by default, but a modifier can turn it into five-shot, with a panel of 32×5, for 160 theoretical damage if every arrow hits at close range, making it the strongest bow in the game. The farming method relies on Rock Octoroks (each Octorok works only once per Blood Moon), and the steps are as follows:
1先去找一只岩石巨人，位置以鼓隆城周边最方便。动手前先存档，这是整套方法的保险。
Step 1: First, find a Rock Octorok, most conveniently around Goron City. Save before you start, as insurance for the whole method.

2把兽神弓扔到岩石巨人面前，让它吸进去再吐出来。吐出来的弓会带上一个随机词条：先是蓝字或白字的一段词条。
Step 2: Throw the Savage Lynel Bow in front of the Rock Octorok and let it suck it in and spit it back out. The spat-out bow will carry a random modifier: first a white-text modifier.

Step 3: Repeat the suck-in and spit-out once more, and the second modifier has a chance to roll the yellow-text Five-Shot Burst. If it is not five-shot, reload your save and try again until it appears.

Step 4: Save again immediately after rolling five-shot. Note: re-rolling a bow that already has a modifier will replace it, so confirm that the bow in hand is the one you want to keep before re-rolling.

顺带的好处：岩石巨人吐出的武器耐久会被修满，所以一把快断的兽神弓也可以这样“续命”——先修满再刷词条，一举两得。但别指望一次成功，读档几次是常态，刷之前先把档存好比什么都重要。

A side benefit: a weapon spat out by a Rock Octorok has its durability fully restored, so a nearly broken Savage Lynel Bow can be given a new lease on life this way, restoring it fully before farming modifiers, killing two birds with one stone. But do not expect success on the first try, since reloading a few times is normal, and saving before farming matters more than anything else.
空中慢动作：从高处下落或弹射起飞时拉弓，时间会变慢，适合瞄准弱点。代价是持续消耗精力，精力见底就掉下来了，跳之前先确认精力够不够一套输出。

Bullet time: when you draw your bow while falling from a height or launching into the air, time slows down, which suits aiming at weak points. The cost is continuous Stamina drain, and you will fall once Stamina runs out, so confirm you have enough Stamina for a full round of damage before jumping.

弱点优先：多数敌人的眼睛、头部是弱点，命中出暴击。打人马先射脸把它打跪，再近身输出；打守护者类敌人先射眼睛控场。弱点暴击的收益远大于多射几箭。

Weak points first: most enemies have weak points at their eyes or head, and hitting them scores a critical hit. Against a Lynel, shoot its face first to make it kneel, then move in for close damage; against enemies with an eye weak point, shoot the eye first to control the fight. The payoff from weak-point critical hits far exceeds firing a few more arrows.

Weak points first: most enemies have weak points at their eyes or head, and hitting them scores a critical hit.
打人马先射脸把它打跪，再近身输出；
Against a Lynel, shoot its face first to make it kneel, then move in for close damage;

against enemies with an eye weak point, shoot the eye first to control the fight.

Horseback archery: you can draw and shoot while riding, which suits hitting enemies around the outside of a camp while moving, but aiming on horseback feels floaty, so dismount for long-range shots.
抛物线预判：箭会下坠，超远距离要把准星抬高一截。黄昏之弓射程远、下坠小，是超远狙击的专门选择；普通弓打远目标别指望一发命中，先试一发看落点。

Arrow drop prediction: arrows drop, so at extreme range raise your crosshair a notch. The Twilight Bow has long range and little drop, making it the dedicated choice for extreme-range sniping; with an ordinary bow against distant targets, do not expect a first-shot hit, so fire one test shot to see where it lands.

If you can only remember three sentences: first, clear the map early on with the Knight's Bow and the Royal Bow, and do not force the chase for a Savage Lynel Bow; second, divide eyeball arrows and Bomb Flowers by situation, and arrows will always be enough; third, the five-shot Savage Lynel Bow is a late-game endgame goal, and before you farm one, a triple-shot Savage Lynel Bow plus high-damage Fuse materials is already enough to beat the vast majority of battles.
弓箭系统的精髓不在面板，而在“弓加箭矢”的组合思维：单发弓配普通箭打点名，多连弓配余料打爆发，追踪箭配移动目标。组合对了，一把中期弓也能打出后期伤害；组合错了，毕业弓也只能刮痧。

The essence of the bow system is not the stat panel, but bow-plus-arrow combo thinking: single-shot bows with ordinary arrows for picking off targets, multi-shot bows with Fuse materials for burst damage, and homing arrows for moving targets. With the right combo, even a mid-game bow can deal late-game damage; with the wrong combo, even an endgame bow will only scratch enemies.
